Courtesy: La Salle Green Hills/Facebook

[5:40PM] #VictoriaIsland #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic flow from McWen Bridge inward Bonny Camp Roundabout remains steady at this hour. Movement along Ahmadu Bello Way is generally good, with only slight delays approaching Adeola Odeku Junction as a result of traffic light alternations. The return journey towards Bonny Camp is also experiencing light delays but remains manageable.

Vehicular movement from Ahmadu Bello Way through Adetokunbo Ademola to connect Eko Hotel Roundabout is smooth, although traffic around Eko Hotel inward the roundabout is slightly busy but still moving. Similarly, Ajose Adeogun, Ligali Ayorinde, and Oniru Water Corporation are recording steady traffic flow in both directions.

From Bonny Camp Under Bridge en route Kofo Abayomi, vehicular movement is steady. However, traffic inward Oniru Kilimanjaro is busy but moving, largely due to closing-hour rush and alternating traffic patterns. The stretch from Oniru Kilimanjaro through Akin Adesola, Law School, and Civic Centre is also experiencing heavy but moving traffic, affected by high vehicle influx and traffic light delays.

At Civic Centre inward BJ1004, through School Corner down to Sandfield and onward to Lekki Phase 1, traffic is presently steady. The return journey from Lekki, through Toll Plaza and Sandfield down to BJ, is also good with only minor delays at alternating points. Movement from BJ to Civic Centre is gradually building up, while Civic Centre inward Ramp Bridge is busy.

Meanwhile, Civic Centre through Law School, connecting Akin Adesola down to Kilimanjaro, maintains encouraging movement. Traffic is also gathering from Radisson Blu en route Kofo Abayomi, while Kofo Abayomi inward Bonny Camp Roundabout back to McWen Bridge is moving slowly, attributed to evening rush hour and the ongoing alteration beneath Bonny Camp Bridge.

Our men are present at key locations ensuring ease of movement. 

#FollowLASTMA
